budget_items.what_was_recorded: As of January 30, 2026, the Town had experienced 18 snow events and expended the snow and ice budget at 147.2 percent
budget_items.quote: as of january 30, 2026, the town had experienced 18 snow events. the snow and ice budget of $355,571.39 had been expended at 147.2 percent, totaling $523,418.07.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Annual operating and maintenance costs for the TCP Building following school department vacation in summer 2025
budget_items.quote: annual operating and maintenance costs for the building are approximately $120,000. the expected 50 percent reduction in energy costs following partial decommissioning of the building has not been realized

budget_items.what_was_recorded: DPW Director submitted grant application for design phase of Goodrich Street culvert over Easter Brook
budget_items.quote: dpw director bill bernard submitted a grant application in the amount of $150,000 to fund the design phase of the goodrich street culvert over easter brook.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Two Warrant Articles related to the Town's 300th Anniversary including multi-year allocation and Gift Fund Article
budget_items.quote: two warrant articles related to the town's 300th anniversary were noted: a multi-year allocation of $15,000 and a gift fund article for donations and sale of merchandise

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Town Manager advised that FY27 budget cycle will be challenging due to major cost drivers projected to exceed revenue growth, likely requiring an override
budget_items.quote: major cost drivers including health insurance, retirement assessment, and school transportation are projected to exceed revenue growth. she stated that absent service reductions, an override is likely required.
